market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham United are an established Premier League club with significant financial resources, a strong squad including Bowen, Kudus, and Paquetá, and a new manager in Julen Lopetegui. Even after a disappointing 2024–25 season, the underlying quality makes relegation highly unlikely; true relegation probability is likely ~15% at most. The market’s 34.5% implied chance is far too pessimistic, creating a large edge on “No”.
evidence_points: West Ham have not finished in the relegation zone since the 2010–11 season and consistently invest to maintain top‑flight status.
Bookmakers’ ante‑post relegation odds for 2025–26 were ~8/1 (11% implied) for West Ham in early summer 2025, far below 34.5%.
The squad retains proven Premier League performers and has a stable financial footing, reducing the typical risk factors that cause unexpected relegations.
